attributes.board_name: Hawaii Department of Commerce and Consumer Affairs, Professional and Vocational Licensing Division (Social Worker Program)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses approved by NASW, NASW chapters or ASWB
rules.new_licensee_rule: First-time licensees are exempt from CE for the first renewal.
rules.audit_note: Random audits by the Director; proof due within 60 days of the notice. Do not submit certificates with the renewal.
rules.notes: Applies to licensees on active status. All licenses renew triennially by June 30 regardless of issue date (2025, 2028, 2031); hours must be earned in the 3 years before renewal. Licensed by the DCCA Director (no board).
rules.rule_quote: All Social Worker licensees on “active” status must complete at least 45 hours of Continuing Education (CE) credits…
